title: How a 50 kW PEM electrolyser runs at a fertiliser plant in Pune
description: Hydrotek's plant team walks through a 50 kW PEM electrolyser running at a fertiliser plant near Pune: how the stack is sized, why the DM water skid matters, what the daily checks are and what it costs to run per kilogram of hydrogen. Sample video: replace before launch.

chapters.title: Why PEM for a small plant
Water quality and the DM skid
Running cost per kg of hydrogen

transcript:
H2 India:
We're at a fertiliser plant near Pune. What did the site need to change?
Anand Deshpande:
It needed a lot of hydrogen ever so slightly purer. The main addition was a demineralised water skid.
H2 India:
How often do you check the stack?
Anand Deshpande:
Every day for pressure and temperature, and a full inspection every quarter.
